description: This Java class implements PayPal payment processing functionalities, including initializing transactions, authorizing, capturing, and refunding payments via PayPal's API. It manages different payment flows such as express checkout, handles interactions with PayPal SDK, and processes transaction details for online payment workflows.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements PayPal payment workflows including initialization, authorization, capturing, and refunds for PayPal express checkout.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates essential configuration keys (api, username, signature) for the PayPal integration.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to initialize a PayPal transaction.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment using a PayPal payment token, delegating to processTransaction.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Sets up a PayPal express checkout transaction, including creating a payment details request, setting return/cancel URLs, invoking PayPal API to get a token, and preparing a transaction record.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Performs authorization and immediate capture in PayPal using provided payment details.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund (full or partial) for a PayPal transaction, invoking PayPal's refund API and returning the refund transaction details.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles the common process of completing a PayPal express checkout transaction, including retrieving checkout details, executing payment, and recording transaction info.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized PayPal transaction, updating the transaction records accordingly.
